documents.title: Соглашение СССР и Швеции о разграничении континентального шельфа, шведской рыболовной зоны и советской экономической зоны в Балтийском море
documents.publicationCitation: UNTS Vol. 1557, I-27075, pp. 275 ff.; authentic Swedish and Russian texts; provisionally effective 16 May 1988 and definitively effective 22 June 1988.
documents.notes: Article 1 requires straight rhumb-line (loxodrome) segments joining Article 2 points A1-A17. Article 2 publishes both Swedish RT38/chart coordinates and Soviet chart No. 1150 coordinates and declares the two systems equally valid. The History Core recipe uses the Soviet system literally; no silent conversion to WGS84 is asserted.
